stage1.impression: A clear ball with an etched meteorite slice on a black puck, set against a cream wall that is one flat value. The glass has almost no dark limb, so the ball dissolves into the wall, and the slice reads as a flat, repeating graphic with a pale ghost around it rather than a $4,000 piece of iron.

blocking_9: The ball's limb reads as a defined dark edge on both sides (lum_p5 below 190 in a 40 px band at the silhouette); it is now 214/201 against a 234.7 wall
The wall has a visible falloff (range 10 to 30 levels across the upper frame), not one value of 234.7 (range 1.0)
The wall and floor colour match the house set: delta E under 3 against #EAE4DA on the wall (now 5.0) and under 6 against #ECE7DF on the floor (now 10.3)
The ball's lower body separates from the wall: it is 231.5, the wall 234.7, so the glass has no weight
No bright band across the slice: rows y 1110 to 1145 run at about 199 against 155 above and below
The etch reads as a real Gibeon figure (irregular kamacite lamellae of varied width, fine taenite, mottled plessite), not tiled triangles of equal size
The black base shows a soft anodised sheen instead of a near-black hole (median 11.6, middle columns at 5)
